game.name: Forza Horizon 2 (USA)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Pt,Zh,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: Forza Horizon 2 will take place in southern Europe and will feature hundreds of cars to drive, including the 2014 Lamborghini Huracán, which is the cover car for the game. The Xbox 360 version is built on the original Forza Horizon engine, and is led by Sumo Digital.
